room-with-secret-object.name: Secret Room
room-with-secret-object.description: A room filled with ancient artifacts and mysterious symbols. The door is heavily guarded, but there seems to be an exit through a hidden passage.
room-with-secret-object.image_prompt: fantasy secret room, arcane symbols on walls

forbidden-room-object-of-interest.name: Object of Interest Location
forbidden-room-object-of-interest.description: A location where the object-of-interest might be found. This is separate from the secret room but accessible through it.
forbidden-room-object-of-interest.image_prompt: fantasy mysterious object, glowing and enigmatic

object-of-interest.name: Object of Interest
object-of-interest.description: A shimmering object with intricate magical properties. It has the power to grant knowledge and insight into forbidden arts.
object-of-interest.image_prompt: shiny mysterious object, glowing and enigmatic

hero.name: Alden the Apprentice
hero.description: A brave young student looking to complete his studies and prove himself. He is still in a state of immaturity but has great potential.
hero.image_prompt: fantasy young student, looks like he's about to embark on a quest

forbidden-room-professor.name: Professor Zephyr
forbidden-room-professor.description: A renowned professor who teaches the most arcane and dangerous magic. His lectures are captivating but his students fear him.

dialogues.before_talk: Prof. Zephyr: Alden, I've decided to give you a task of utmost importance. But first, we need to get into the secret room in the basement.
dialogues.after_talk: Prof. Zephyr: What did you expect? The only way is through that locked door at the end of this corridor.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Prof. Zephyr: Finally, your loyalty has not been misplaced. Here's the key I promised.
dialogues.hostile: Prof. Zephyr: Alden! You've managed to sneak into my secret room? What are you planning to do with that?
